parameters.name: All
parameters.description: Specifies whether to delete all tags. Default value: **false**. This parameter is valid only when **TagKeys** is empty.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The list of resources from which you want to delete tags.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **INSTANCE**.

parameters.name: TagKeys
parameters.description: The list of tag keys to delete. A maximum of 20 items can be specified.
